sync_locus.description: Multi-channel synchronization is implemented at the ADC array + Artix-7 FPGA layer (shared convert clock into the fabric), not in the FX3 ARM firmware.
sync_locus.notes: FX3 firmware strings show no sample/sync handling; SPEC requires a shared convert clock across 16 ADCs, placing the sync locus in ADC+FPGA.
